svg.text: From raw rows to governed answers
Two human-approved contracts declare what the data means. Deterministic code generates everything downstream.
EVERY CHANGE IS A REVIEWED PULL REQUEST
Two narrow agents draft contracts. Three CI gates judge human and agent work identically.
Failures stop the line; nothing an agent writes reaches the warehouse unreviewed.
byte-reproducible builds · conservation tests C1 to C5 on every PR · 44,721 = 44,721 · one local DuckDB file · Apache-2.0
The full layer flow, the type journey, and the star ERD live in docs/diagrams, each with a Mermaid twin.
